rules: Public replies on Google are signed 'The Brightside team' and never mention pricing or a specific employee.
Only the owner (Janie) approves anything that publishes to the Google listing - a draft goes to her first.
The legal business name on every directory is 'Brightside Fixtures'; the marketing name is never used in NAP fields.
